foto-01.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: CACE Imatges N1 single-word vocabulary stimulus. Intended concept: PICOR / itching. ONE synthetic studio PHOTOGRAPH. Real camera realism, believable skin texture and hair, soft even neutral studio light. No illustration or cartoon. Subject: a 12-year-old girl with light olive skin and brown bobbed hair in a plain teal T-shirt. Visual content: A person experiencing ITCH on the forearm: head and upper torso visible on white, looking at their bare forearm while gently scratching it with the fingertips of the other hand. Clear nail-skin contact, normal mild itchy skin without wounds or rash. Two arms, two anatomically natural hands each five fingers, no scratching tool, no insects, no symbols. The scratching action must be immediately visible.  Composition: ONE square image, pure white background, isolated clear subject, Full head, ears, neck and upper shoulders, scalp entirely inside frame and white margin above it; natural portrait crop at upper chest. Human face large, directly readable. Minimal context only when essential. NO text, labels, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, emoji, decorative symbols, arrows, borders, panels, collages or montage. Anatomically plausible proportions, correct eyes and mouth, no extra limbs or fingers. Appropriate for school use and varied ages. Produce ONE standalone image only.

review.scope: Revisió visual de producció pel mateix assistent que ha preparat els prompts; no és una lectura cega ni una validació amb participants.
